# Sbeydeh Viveros-Walton for San Leandro City Council
Learn More
## Sbeydeh Viveros-Walton for San Leandro City Council
San Leandro is brimming with opportunity and I want to continue to be an active and unwavering community advocate in addressing the pressing issues of our city, while strengthening our economy and resiliency.
I was unanimously appointed to serve as your San Leandro City Councilwoman representing District 1, and I humbly ask for your support to continue building on the work we have started and to serve as a conduit between community and City Hall.
